name: SWSE Graphics
author: SWSE
description: The SWSE graphics overhaul. Adds screen-space post-processing and lighting effects (sharpening, bloom, ambient occlusion, and screen-space global illumination) rendered by SWSE, the Stranger's Wrath Script Extender. Requires SWSE installed in the game's bin folder. Switch it on with graphics = on in SWSEMods/features.txt, then press F10 in-game to toggle the effect (F11 reloads graphics.txt). Enable/disable this mod like any other; it only affects the 3D scene, not menus or HUD.
